scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 25 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-dudergofskaya-elevation-zelenogor.story: A 151 km round trip from Krasnoye Selo - roughly 2 h 36 in the saddle. It goes by way of The Monastery Troitse-Sergieva Pustin, Historical Centre of the Town of Lomonosov, Zelenogorsky and back through Historical Centre of the Town of Lomonosov. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Socotra h → Socotra Archipelago
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 49 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
